wgIni.amneziaIncompatible: This is an AmneziaWG config: the server expects an obfuscated handshake (S1–S4, H1–H4) that the app does not support yet. A plain WireGuard connection to it will most likely fail.
wgIni.amneziaJunkDropped: AmneziaWG junk-packet settings (Jc, I1–I5, J1–J3) are not supported and were ignored: the connection runs as plain WireGuard without them.
